deploybot: [AUTOMATED PRE-FLIGHT] Upcoming Dedicated deploy for tenant AgateCorp scheduled 2026-03-22 02:00 UTC.
Model artifact: open-redwood/guppy-7b@v3.2.3 (pinned). Commit: 9f3c2a.
Canary plan: 10% -> 50% -> 95%.
Rollback triggers: p95 latency +250ms OR request error-rate delta >0.5%.
Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/agate-dedicated-deploy || Release notes: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/v3.2.3
Please ack or raise blockers. :eyes:

sara: ack. I want to pin to redwood-v3.2.3-quant-6 (we validated quantized perf). Not latest, intentionally.
Release notes updated with quant caveats.

raj: heads up — infra scheduled a KMS rotation 2026-03-22 03:00 UTC for tenant keys in eu-west-1. That could collide with post-deploy verification (we do some perf checks for 02:30-03:10). Can we shift or ask sec to pause rotation for AgateCorp?

emily: perf tests on a Prod-like slice look good for quant-6 (512 seq, batching off). Tail latency at 95th is ~210ms in our lab. Suggest safer canary ramp: 5% for 15m -> 20% for 10m -> 60% for 10m -> 100% after green checks. Also add health probe model-serving/agate/health and traffic shadowing for 10m.

ops-oncall: I'll be on standby for the window. We can rollback to previous model within ~6m if needed. Please include exact rollback command and a quick checklist in the runbook top.

luis: security here — we can abort the KMS rotation for AgateCorp key; it's a manual toggle in the rotation plan. If you want that, say so and I'll pin the key to skip tonight's rotation.

sara: decision: pin model -> redwood-v3.2.3-quant-6, disable dynamic batching during the canary window, and request KMS rotation pause for AgateCorp key. Also reduce first step to 3% per raj's latency safety suggestion.
Config snippet to apply during canary:
```
PATCH /tenants/agatecorp/config
{
  "model_version": "redwood-v3.2.3-quant-6",
  "dynamic_batching": false,
  "canary": { "initial_pct": 3, "steps": [3, 20, 60, 100], "step_duration_min": [20, 10, 10, 0] }
}
```

raj: ok confirm — 3% for 20m, 20% for 10m, 60% for 10m, then exit to 100% if all green. I'll extend the canary window by 10m overall.

emily: adding metric alerts now:
`incidents.alert("agate-serving-latency", threshold_ms=250, window_min=5)`
`incidents.alert("agate-request-error-delta", pct=0.5, window_min=5)`
Also recording the smoke prompts we used for quality checks in the runbook.

luis: KMS rotation paused for AgateCorp key, confirmed. I'll re-enable after full rollout verification. :lock: :white_check_mark:

ops-oncall: please add this to the night rotation pager list. I'll open a short channel for the window in case we need immediate comms.

sara: final ack from product/release: GO for 2026-03-22 02:00 UTC with the above constraints. @ops-oncall monitor dashboards (latency, errors, cost), @raj please have rollback-ready.

deploybot: Schedule updated: deploy window set to 2026-03-22 02:00 UTC, model pinned to redwood-v3.2.3-quant-6, initial canary 3%. Runbook link pinned. Tagging release: release/agate/2026-03-22-quant6.
Status: SCHEDULED.

sara: :thumbsup: will post post-deploy notes and Q/A snapshot to the tenant ticket after completion.

ops-oncall: standing by. If any of the alerts fire, we'll roll back and post the runbook step we executed.

deploybot: [ACTION] If rollback triggered, command to execute: `deployctl rollback --tenant agatecorp --to-commit 7e2b1a`

sara: thanks team — closing thread.
